Accept stage, historical wiki/PR, untraced lifecycle-registration and visual-animation deferrals across the listed facts and links. Item-kind construction, initialization-like operations and callback names do not independently establish Underground Maze placement, historical provenance or visible swallowing/spitting. The current handoff correctly repairs the prior rejection of link:ac95ff72-5206-4e9d-9c1b-609659aa62db. Same-state reselection does not contradict its state-selection explanation. Accept pattern-membership deferral consistently with the state-1 link. The animation query inspects AObj activity; shard-local statements that it was unread are not aggregate findings of contrary behavior. State 20 has animation index -1, so its state requests remove animation rather than establish animation cycling.

Accept rejection of collision-status interpretations of it_8027C794 and correction of cleanup interpretations of it_8026D5CC. The former simply returns false; the latter prepares collision data and returns a collision query. Other delegated collision operations remain distinct from this inert final return. NULL-callback collision handling can perform side effects before returning, so its boolean alone does not describe all behavior.

Accept the velocity and orientation qualifications. Reconstruction does not normalize the supplied normal and clears all velocity for zero facing; equal-magnitude preservation is not universal. Floor contact gates orientation processing, and tolerance or remaining count can cause early snapping. Vertical acceleration is governed by a pre-update threshold, not a clamp. These definitions resolve shared-helper uncertainty without adopting stronger baseline guarantees.

Accept movement-family and counter qualifications. State-1/state-2 Walk hypotheses collide and obscure orientation-sensitive behavior; no merge or original-name conclusion follows. Low-displacement recovery requires both axis tests and counts qualifying evaluations, because bypass branches preserve the counter. State-2 decisions test zero before decrement and set x3C only on successful detection. State-3 physics adds the attribute term, so downward motion is not established merely by its name.

Accept acquisition and pursuit qualifications. Equal X selects +1; failed acquisition clears x3C without necessarily clearing x50. State 8 has separate timeout, missing-target and proximity exits. Direct target-directed movement and capture-entry wiring are supported, while original naming, stage placement and visible attack interpretations remain deferred.

Accept guarded capture-lifetime qualifications. Fighter-side code establishes hidden captivity, periodic damage, timer-triggered release initiation and captured-fighter damage notification. Release excludes state 8 and requires a matching non-null victim before clearing three references. Pickup and destruction share selector 1, so neither unconditional release nor pickup-specific selector semantics is supported. xD09 assignment does not by itself establish all consumer behavior, and capture callbacks serve states 9/10 as well as 11/12.

Accept damage-state corrections and remaining defeat/launch deferrals. Damage dispatch uses the threshold OR state-19 condition and Camera_RequestQuake. State-6 zero-entry updates exit without decrement; every nonzero value takes the decrement path, not merely positive values. Conditional ceiling contact does not guarantee attachment. Empty local physics establishes neither stationary motion nor grounded motion, and inert collision delegation does not supply continuing dynamics.

Accept remaining bounded helper and lifecycle deferrals while retaining directly verified operations. Collision callbacks establish delegated events and state destinations, not all gameplay labels. The event helper explicitly invokes its callback on bit 0; source-level registration of an empty physics callback does not prove that slot is required. Shared reset clears XY velocity and owner, but broader lifecycle or visual interpretations require additional evidence. The synthesized functionality document correctly distinguishes these limitations from aggregate ignorance of helpers already examined.
